h1:
Where to Stay in Phrae?
12 Hotels We've Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites
heroSub: Twelve Phrae hotels across every budget — old-town boutiques inside the city walls, a loft-style B&B, teak-house and rice-field homestays, down to hostels and budget stays. Starting from around ฿590–900/night.
heroStats: 🏘️ 4 key areas (old town·Yom riverside·Thung Hong·edge of town)
introH2: 🏙️ Why does choosing the right area in Phrae matter?
introHtml: Phrae is a small, walkable town where each area has its own feel — Nai Wiang (the old town inside the walls) is the heart, within walking reach of Khum Chao Luang, Kad Kong Kao market, Wat Luang and the walking street, ideal if you want to explore the old town and eat well without driving · The Yom riverside is a quiet zone near the walking street · Thung Hong is the indigo-cloth (mor hom) district and the road up to Phra That Cho Hae · and the edge of town (Pa Maet, Ban Thin, Suan Khuean) suits those driving themselves who want a quiet, rural or rice-field setting. Many people book without thinking about the area, then end up driving in and out of town every day. This guide rounds up 12 Phrae hotels we've picked across every tier — each with an honest take from real reviews, prices compared on 3 sites, and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Phrae has no metro; the town is compact and many stays sit in the old town within walking reach of each other · You can reach Phrae by bus to the terminal, by train to Den Chai then onward by road, or by flying into Phrae Airport, about 10 minutes from town · In town, ride-hailing or renting a motorbike/car is easy. The main areas in this guide: Nai Wiang (old town) — Khum Chao Luang, Kad Kong Kao, Wat Luang, the walking street, all walkable · Yom riverside — quiet, near the walking street · Thung Hong — the indigo-cloth district, road up to Phra That Cho Hae · Edge of town (Pa Maet·Ban Thin·Suan Khuean) — quiet, rural, rice fields, best with your own car · Most stays have parking.

entries.name: Huen Him Kong Hotel Phrae
entries.revCount: 327 reviews · strong score in the old town
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Wiang · Wat Luang community · walk to Khum Chao Luang
entries.addr: 16/1 Soi Wat Luang Community, Thung Kwao, Mueang Phrae
entries.storyHtml: Huen Him Kong is a small 9-room boutique in the heart of Phrae's old town, the most consistently reviewed stay in this list, scoring 8.8 across 327 reviews. What guests love is the warm guesthouse feel — like staying at a relative's home — attentive staff, and a Nai Wiang location within walking reach of Khum Chao Luang, Wat Luang and Kad Kong Kao market. The balcony rooms where you can sit and take in the old-town air are the highlight, and from ฿850 it's good value for the location and the score.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pick a balcony room (Double/Twin with Balcony) for the full old-town atmosphere · it's a small hotel with few rooms, so it fills up fast on weekends and during festivals — book ahead.
pros: Nai Wiang location, walk to Khum Chao Luang and Kad Kong Kao
Warm guesthouse feel, attentive staff
Rooms with a balcony to take in the old-town air
Heavily reviewed (327) with a strong score in this old-town group
cons: Just 9 rooms — fills up fast on weekends
No pool — built for resting and exploring the old town

entries.name: Hug Inn Phrae
entries.revCount: 32 reviews · highest score among the 3-star group
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Wiang · Phrae old town · Thetsaban 2 Rd
entries.addr: Thetsaban 2 Rd, Nai Wiang, Mueang Phrae
entries.storyHtml: Hug Inn is a boutique B&B with the highest score among the 3-star group in this guide at 9.2. The draw is industrial-loft styling mixed with the indigo (mor hom) tones Phrae is known for, breakfast included with every room, and owners who look after you like a friend's place. The Nai Wiang location is walkable to the old town. There's an 80-sqm Family Room that sleeps up to 6 with two bathrooms — a fit for a group.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The King Room with its high ceiling and sitting corner is worth it for an airier room · for a family or group of friends the Family Room sleeps 6 and beats booking several rooms.
pros: Highest score, 9.2, among the 3-star group
Breakfast included with every room; owners look after you well
Loft design in indigo tones, with real Phrae character
Has a Family Room for 6 — good for groups
cons: A small stay with few rooms — fills up fast during festivals
Few reviews so far (32), though the score is excellent

entries.name: The Indigo House Phrae
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thung Hong · road up to Phra That Cho Hae
tags: 🚗 Road up to Phra That Cho Hae
entries.addr: 39 Moo 5, Yantarakitkosol Rd, Thung Hong, Mueang Phrae
entries.storyHtml: The Indigo House is an indigo-cloth-themed boutique in the Thung Hong district, heavily reviewed with 275 reviews and a score of 8.6. The draw is a design that threads Phrae's signature mor hom indigo through the whole hotel — photogenic — with rooms in several sizes from Standard up to Family. The Thung Hong location suits drivers heading up to Phra That Cho Hae or shopping for indigo cloth, and from ฿790 it's good value for a boutique with a clear design.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The Deluxe is roomier and some have a balcony, worth it for the space · it's in the Thung Hong district, handy for indigo shopping, but about 5–10 minutes' drive to the old town.
pros: Indigo-cloth design throughout — distinctive Phrae character
Rooms in several sizes, from Standard to Family
Heavily reviewed (275) with a steady 8.6
Thung Hong location, handy for Phra That Cho Hae and indigo cloth
cons: In the Thung Hong district — not walkable to the old town, you'll drive
No pool

entries.name: PhoomThai Garden Hotel
entries.revCount: 1,109 reviews · the most-reviewed in this list
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Wiang · central Phrae · Sasibut Rd
entries.addr: 31 Sasibut Rd, Nai Wiang, Mueang Phrae
entries.storyHtml: PhoomThai Garden is a Lanna garden hotel in the centre of town and the most-reviewed in this guide — over 1,109 reviews, scoring 8.1. The draw is a leafy teak-garden setting with a pool and spa on site, rare for a stay at this price in Phrae. The Nai Wiang location lets you drive or walk to the old town. It's a solid pick for families who want both a pool and a central base.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The Grand Deluxe is roomy with a sofa bed, worth it for a group · it's an older hotel kept up over the years, some buildings look dated, so ask for a renovated wing for newer rooms.
pros: Most-reviewed in this guide, 1,100+ — lots of real data
Has a pool and spa — rare at this price in Phrae
Leafy Lanna teak garden, a restful setting
Nai Wiang location · ample parking
cons: An older hotel — some buildings and rooms look dated
Average score lower than the small boutiques, as room standards vary by wing

entries.name: Come Moon Loft Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Yom riverside · central Phrae · near the walking street
entries.addr: 7 Chetawan Rd Soi 1, Nai Wiang, Mueang Phrae
entries.storyHtml: Come Moon Loft is a loft-style boutique on the Yom riverside in town, with a low entry price of just ฿650, scoring 8.7. The draw is raw bare-concrete loft styling with an edgy look, and a Yom-riverside location near the walking street, handy for going out at night. Rooms aren't large but are clean and simply done — a fit for couples or friends who want location and design on a budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pick the Standard Twin if you'd rather sleep in separate beds · this place is about location and design, the rooms aren't big — if you want more space, look at another type in this list.
pros: Yom-riverside location near the walking street, easy night-time strolls
Raw bare-concrete loft design, photogenic
Low entry price of just ฿650, good value for an in-town location
Clean, simply-styled rooms — a fit for couples or friends
cons: Rooms aren't big — built more for sleeping than lingering in
Few reviews so far (37)

entries.name: Need A Nap Hostel Phrae
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Wiang · central old town · Charoen Mueang Rd
entries.addr: 118 Charoen Mueang Rd, Nai Wiang, Mueang Phrae
entries.storyHtml: Need A Nap is a hostel with a cafe and the highest score among stays at this price, 9.3 across 100 reviews. What guests love is the cleanliness, the minimalist styling, an in-house cafe to relax in, and private rooms with their own bathroom — no sharing needed. The Nai Wiang location in the central old town makes it easy to explore and find food. From ฿650 it suits solo travellers, couples or groups of friends after good value.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For 3–4 people, pick the ensuite Triple or the Duplex Quadruple — better value than several rooms · stop by the in-house cafe in the morning before heading out.
pros: High 9.3 score, clean rooms and shared spaces
Has an in-house cafe to relax in and grab morning coffee
Private rooms with their own bathroom — no sharing
Nai Wiang location in the central old town · good value
cons: It's a hostel — rooms are small, built for resting
Popular rooms fill up fast on long weekends

entries.name: SuanGlangNa Homestay
entries.revCount: 33 reviews · highest score in this list
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Suan Khuean/Ban Thin · edge of Phrae town
entries.storyHtml: SuanGlangNa is a boutique homestay amid the rice fields and the highest-scoring stay in this guide at 9.4. The selling point is the atmosphere of a house out in the rice fields with mountain views — quiet and private, with nature-led decor — a fit for those who really want to escape the bustle. There are rooms in several outlooks: garden, mountain and courtyard. It sits on the edge of town in the Suan Khuean/Ban Thin area, best for drivers, and from ฿657 it's great value for a score this high.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For the best outlook pick the Queen Bed Mountain View · it's on the edge of town amid the fields, so bring your own car and pick up some food on the way, as there aren't many shops nearby.
pros: Highest score in this guide, 9.4, with a rice-field setting
Quiet and private — a fit for escaping the bustle
Rooms in several outlooks: garden, mountain and courtyard
Nature-led decor · great-value entry price
cons: On the edge of town amid the fields — you'll need to drive
Few shops nearby — bring some food along

entries.name: Hop Inn Phrae
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Wiang · central Phrae · Ratdamnoen Rd
entries.addr: 38 Ratdamnoen Rd, Nai Wiang, Mueang Phrae
entries.storyHtml: Hop Inn is a budget chain that delivers a consistent standard, scoring a high 9.2. The draw is clean rooms and comfy beds to the same standard at every branch — no guesswork — a fit for anyone wanting a clean, affordable bed in a central location. There's free parking and free Wi-Fi. The rooms aren't flashy, but they work well for a one-night stopover or for travellers who'd rather not gamble on an unfamiliar stay.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Prices rise on long weekends and during festivals, so booking ahead gets a better rate · it's a clean place to sleep with no pool or big breakfast, so plan to find food around town.
pros: Consistent chain standard, clean rooms and comfy beds
High 9.2 score, dependable — no guesswork
Free parking and free Wi-Fi
Nai Wiang, central location · affordable
cons: Plain rooms with no boutique-style design
No pool or large buffet breakfast

entries.name: B2 Phrae Boutique & Budget Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pa Maet · edge of Phrae town · Phaya Phon Rd
entries.addr: 224 Moo 7, Phaya Phon Rd, Pa Maet, Mueang Phrae
entries.storyHtml: B2 Phrae is a budget chain hotel, the cheapest in this guide from just ฿590, and heavily reviewed with 596 reviews, scoring 8.6. The draw is the B2 chain standard — clean rooms, comfy beds, very low rates — a fit for budget travellers who drive themselves. The Pa Maet location on the edge of town is a short drive from the old town. There's a 30-sqm Junior Suite for a small family, plus free parking.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a group or small family, the roomier Junior Suite is better value · it's on the edge of town in Pa Maet, so bringing your own car is easiest as you'll drive into the old town.
pros: Cheapest in this guide, from ฿590
B2 chain standard, clean rooms and comfy beds
Heavily reviewed (596) — plenty of real, dependable data
Has a Junior Suite for families · free parking
cons: In Pa Maet on the edge of town — you'll drive into the old town
Plain chain rooms with no standout design

entries.name: Baanthep Antique Homestay
entries.revCount: 21 reviews · antique teak house, strong score
entries.badge: 🪵 Antique teak house · inside the walls
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Wiang · inside the old city walls · Thetsaban 2 Rd
entries.addr: 8/1 Thetsaban 2 Rd, Nai Wiang, Mueang Phrae
entries.storyHtml: Baanthep is a homestay in an old teak house filled with antiques — like sleeping in a small museum, scoring 9.0. The selling point is the original teak-house atmosphere and the owner's antique collection, a vintage feel you won't find in an ordinary hotel. It sits inside the old city walls, walkable to Kad Kong Kao market and the old ramparts. There's a Family Suite, plus free parking — a fit for those who want a stay with a story in the old town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a family, pick the roomier Deluxe Family Suite · it's an old wooden house with a vintage feel but homestay-level facilities — if you love antiques and teak houses, you'll enjoy it.
pros: Old teak house full of antiques, a vintage atmosphere
Inside the old city walls, walk to Kad Kong Kao
Strong 9.0 score · free parking
Has a Family Suite for families
cons: An old wooden house with homestay-level facilities
Few reviews so far (21) · few rooms, fills up fast

entries.name: Taris Art Hotel Phrae
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Wiang · Phrae town · Ratchadamnoen Rd
entries.addr: 69 Ratchadamnoen Rd, Nai Wiang, Mueang Phrae
entries.storyHtml: Taris Art is a budget art-styled hotel in central Nai Wiang from just ฿650, scoring 8.2 across 92 reviews. The draw is art-led decor with more colour than you'd expect at this price, and a Nai Wiang location you can explore the town from. Rooms aren't large but are clean, with several types from Deluxe Twin to Junior Suite — a fit for budget travellers who still want a touch of design in the centre of town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Prices rise on holidays, so booking ahead helps · for a group, pick the largest Junior Suite · rooms aren't big, built for resting and exploring the town.
pros: Art-styled decor with more colour than peers at this price
Nai Wiang location, central, easy to explore the town
Budget price from ฿650 · several room types
A fair number of reviews (92) with a steady 8.2
cons: Rooms aren't big — built more for sleeping than lingering
Basic facilities, no pool

entries.name: Huern Na Na Boutique Hotel
entries.revCount: 22 reviews · boutique with a saltwater pool
entries.badge: 🏊 Has a saltwater pool · Nai Wiang
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Wiang · central Phrae · Sasibut Rd
entries.addr: 7/9 Sasibut Rd, Nai Wiang, Mueang Phrae
entries.storyHtml: Huern Na Na is a Nai Wiang boutique with a saltwater pool — rare for a stay in Phrae town. The draw is the pool and roomy suites up to 72 sqm for special occasions. The Nai Wiang location is walkable to the old town. Its average score sits at 7.4, lower than others in this guide, because some reviews mention inconsistent upkeep and service — but if a pool in the centre of town is the priority, from ฿890 it remains a rare option.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Check recent reviews and the room's condition before booking, as the standard is inconsistent · for more space pick a suite · the main draw is the pool — if that's not your priority, there are higher-scoring options in this guide.
pros: Has a saltwater pool — rare for a stay in Phrae town
Has roomy suites up to 72 sqm for special occasions
Nai Wiang location, walk to the old town

adviceTitle: How to pick the right Phrae hotel for your trip

advice.head: Want to explore the old town, Nai Wiang
advice.bodyHtml: → Huen Him Kong Hotel ฿850, a boutique in the heart of the old town scoring 8.8 · Hug Inn Phrae ฿900, a B&B with breakfast scoring 9.2 · or Baanthep Antique Homestay ฿800, a teak house inside the walls

advice.head: Tight budget, cheapest possible
advice.bodyHtml: → B2 Phrae ฿590, the cheapest budget chain · Come Moon Loft ฿650, a riverside loft · or Taris Art Hotel ฿650, art-styled in town

advice.head: Solo traveller, want a hostel
advice.bodyHtml: → Need A Nap Hostel ฿650, a hostel + cafe scoring 9.3 in the central old town · with private ensuite rooms to choose from

advice.head: Want a quiet rice-field, nature stay
advice.bodyHtml: → SuanGlangNa Homestay ฿657, a rice-field homestay with mountain views and the highest score, 9.4 · quiet and private, best with your own car

advice.head: Want a stay with a pool
advice.bodyHtml: → PhoomThai Garden Hotel ฿900, a Lanna garden with a pool and spa in town · or Huern Na Na Boutique ฿890, with a saltwater pool in Nai Wiang

advice.head: Want design, photogenic stays
advice.bodyHtml: → The Indigo House ฿790, an indigo-cloth theme throughout, in Thung Hong · or Come Moon Loft ฿650, a bare-concrete loft on the Yom riverside

advice.head: Coming as a family or group of friends
advice.bodyHtml: → Hug Inn Phrae ฿900, with a Family Room for 6 · PhoomThai Garden ฿900, a Grand Deluxe with a pool · or Need A Nap ฿650, a Duplex Quadruple for 4

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate, based on real standard-room ranges, and may change by date and season. We recommend checking live prices and comparing all 3 sites before every booking · On long weekends and during festivals (New Year, Songkran and Phrae's own traditional events) prices rise and rooms fill fast — book ahead · Phrae has no metro; you can come by bus, by train to Den Chai, or by flying into Phrae Airport. Many stays sit in the old town within walking reach of each other, while the edge of town is best with your own car, and most stays have parking · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Phrae hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in Phrae?
faq.a: It depends on your plans · To explore the old town, pick Nai Wiang (Huen Him Kong, Hug Inn, Need A Nap, Baanthep, Hop Inn, Taris Art), walkable to Khum Chao Luang, Kad Kong Kao and the walking street · For a riverside feel, pick the Yom riverside (Come Moon Loft) · To head up to Phra That Cho Hae or shop for indigo cloth, pick Thung Hong (The Indigo House) · For a quiet or rice-field stay, pick the edge of town (SuanGlangNa, B2)

faq.q: ❓ How much do Phrae hotels cost?
faq.a: Phrae is an affordable town: budget stays, hostels and homestays start from about ฿590–800 a night · boutiques and 3-star hotels in town run about ฿790–900 · suites and family rooms about ฿1,100–2,200 · Prices rise on long weekends and during festivals, so book ahead.

faq.q: ❓ Can I visit Phrae without a car?
faq.a: Yes, if you stay in Nai Wiang, since the old-town stays and sights — Khum Chao Luang, Kad Kong Kao, Wat Luang — are walkable to each other · But for Phra That Cho Hae, Thung Hong or an edge-of-town stay amid the fields, a car is far handier · In town you can use ride-hailing or rent a motorbike, and many stays have parking for those driving themselves.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Phrae hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) differ by promotion and period, so we recommend opening all 3 to compare before every booking — each review page in this article gives you the price-comparison links, which can save several hundred baht a night.

faq.q: ❓ When is the best time to visit Phrae?
faq.a: The cool season (Nov–Feb) has the best weather, ideal for exploring the old town and heading up to Phra That Cho Hae · During Phrae's festivals and traditional events the atmosphere is lively but rooms fill fast, so book ahead · The rainy season turns the countryside green and rice-field stays are lovely, though come prepared for rain.

faq.q: ❓ What's the difference between staying in Nai Wiang and the edge of town?
faq.a: Nai Wiang (the old town inside the walls) suits a trip focused on exploring the old town, eating well, and wanting to walk everywhere without driving · The edge of town (Pa Maet, Ban Thin, Suan Khuean) suits drivers who want a quiet, rural or rice-field setting, or a lower price, but you'll drive into town to sightsee · Without a car, staying in Nai Wiang is the most convenient.
